nodes.label: Deepslate Bricks Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of polished deepslate bricks. Dark slate-grey with a regular brick grid pattern, mortar lines clearly visible as lighter grey lines separating darker brick faces. Used for refined dungeon architecture and decorative stone construction.
